LanguageData.LP_Rage.label: rage
LanguageData.LP_Rage.description: A barbarian's rage: melee damage ×(1.15 + 0.1 × rage power), sharp and blunt damage taken (including bullets) ×0.7; cannot use spellcasting class abilities.
LanguageData.LP_RecklessAttack.label: reckless attack
LanguageData.LP_RecklessAttack.description: Attacking recklessly with no regard for defense: melee hit +20%, your own melee dodge -20%.
LanguageData.LP_RelentlessRageActive.label: relentless rage
LanguageData.LP_RelentlessRageActive.description: Fury holds the body up: feels no pain and won't fall for now.
LanguageData.LP_LegBerserkerBuff.label: berserker soul
LanguageData.LP_LegBerserkerBuff.description: A legendary barbarian's rage: melee cooldown ×0.85, immune to stuns and mental breaks.
LanguageData.LP_RangerMark.label: hunter's mark
LanguageData.LP_RangerMark.description: Marked by a ranger: the marker deals more damage to it (× 1 + 0.15 × hunter power).
LanguageData.LP_BeastBondBuff.label: beast companion
LanguageData.LP_BeastBondBuff.description: A ranger's animal companion: melee damage ×(1.1 + 0.1 × the master's hunter power), movement ×1.1, armor +10% × hunter power; +20% damage against the master's favored enemy.
LanguageData.LP_HideInPlain.label: hide in plain sight
LanguageData.LP_HideInPlain.description: Hidden in the surroundings: invisible; the next attack deals ×1.5 damage and reveals you.
LanguageData.LP_CunningAction.label: cunning action
LanguageData.LP_ShadowStep.label: shadow step
LanguageData.LP_ShadowStep.description: Melted into the shadows: invisible, revealed after attacking.
LanguageData.LP_PoisonBlade.label: poisoned blade
LanguageData.LP_PoisonBlade.description: The weapon is coated in poison: every hit adds +6% × cunning power toxic buildup to the target (no effect on mechanoids and undead).
LanguageData.LP_DeathMark.label: death mark
LanguageData.LP_DeathMark.description: Marked by a rogue: the marker deals ×2 damage to it; if it dies under the mark, all the marker's rogue abilities finish cooling down.
LanguageData.LP_AssassinStrike.label: assassinate momentum
LanguageData.LP_AssassinStrike.description: Melee damage multiplier of this assassination strike.
